retroConnect.title: Connect RetroAchievements
retroConnect.intro: See your emulated games' achievements next to the rest.
retroConnect.step1: Open your settings on retroachievements.org and copy your Web API key.
retroConnect.step2: Paste your username and the key.
retroConnect.keyNote: LastSave keeps the key encrypted on this computer and only uses it to read your achievements.

retroAccount.expired: RetroAchievements no longer accepts the saved key. Connect again.

retroLink.notConnected: Connect RetroAchievements to choose which of your games this is.
retroLink.note: Linking chooses which game's achievements LastSave shows. Whether your file counts is up to RetroAchievements.
retroLink.empty: None of your RetroAchievements games match.
retroLink.noneYet: You haven't played a game of this console with RetroAchievements yet. Once you do, it links itself.
